blocks.prompt: 7. Use Trapezoidal Rule to approximate the value of the definite integral \(\int_{-1}^{1} (x^{4} - x + 1)\,dx\) taking \(h = 0.2\).
blocks.explanation:
A numerical integration question: estimate a definite integral by the Trapezium Rule.
Given: \(f(x) = x^{4} - x + 1\), interval \([-1, 1]\), \(h = 0.2\), so \(n = \frac{b-a}{h}\).
Plan: list the points and 4-decimal function values, then use h/2 [first + 2(inner) + last].
steps:
Given: \(f(x) = x^{4} - x + 1\), \(a = -1\), \(b = 1\), \(h = 0.2\).
To find: an approximate value of \(\int_{-1}^{1} (x^{4} - x + 1)\,dx\).
Method: the Trapezium Rule, as the question asks. Here \(h\) is given, so find \(n\) first.

Continuity
\(x^{4} - x + 1\) is a polynomial, continuous everywhere, so it is continuous on \([-1, 1]\).
Why: the Trapezium Rule needs a continuous function on the interval.

Number of subintervals and points
\[n = \dfrac{b-a}{h} = \dfrac{1-(-1)}{0.2} = \dfrac{2}{0.2} = 10\]
Points \(x_{i} = a + ih\): \(-1, -0.8, -0.6, -0.4, -0.2, 0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1\)
Why: \(h = \frac{b-a}{n}\) rearranged gives \(n = \frac{b-a}{h}\); 10 subintervals give 11 points.

Add the inner values
\[S = f(x_{1}) + \dots + f(x_{9})\]
\[= 2.2096 + 1.7296 + 1.4256\]
\[+ 1.2016 + 1.0000 + 0.8016\]
\[+ 0.6256 + 0.5296 + 0.6096\]
\[= 10.1328\]
Why: these 9 inner values are shared by two neighbouring trapeziums, so they will be doubled.

Apply the Trapezium Rule
\[\int_{-1}^{1} (x^{4} - x + 1)\,dx\]
\[\approx \dfrac{h}{2}\big[f(x_{0}) + 2S + f(x_{10})\big]\]
\[= 0.1\big[3.0000 + 2(10.1328)\]
\[+ 1.0000\big]\]
\[= 0.1(24.2656)\]
\[= 2.42656 \approx 2.4266\]
Why: \(\frac{h}{2} = 0.1\); the end values are used once and the inner sum twice. Round only at the end.

Check:
\[\int_{-1}^{1} (x^{4} - x + 1)\,dx = \Big[\dfrac{x^{5}}{5} - \dfrac{x^{2}}{2} + x\Big]_{-1}^{1}\]
\[= \dfrac{7}{10} + \dfrac{17}{10} = \dfrac{12}{5} = 2.4\]
The trapezium value 2.4266 is very close (difference 0.0266).

blocks.title: Book correction
blocks.text: The answer key prints 2.9411. This cannot be right: the exact value is \(\frac{12}{5} = 2.4\), and the rule with \(h = 0.2\) gives \(0.1(24.2656) = 2.4266\). The correct answer is 2.4266.
